title: "Unhooking from Thoughts"

Use this for a manageable everyday thought. Defusion does not mean ignoring evidence, dismissing a real problem, or forcing yourself to think positively.

::: {#act-unhooking-app .skill-app data-practice-app="act-unhooking"}
Loading Unhooking from Thoughts...
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A worked example"}
Before opening a message, Noor predicts that it will contain criticism. She names this as a prediction, checks the message, and chooses a reply after reading it. Her nervousness may remain; the useful change is responding to the actual message.
:::
